source: JsonRpcMatcher.methodMatches runs a regex method through MatchingTimeoutExecutor.matchesWithRegexTimeout; a catastrophic `(.*a){25}` against a 40-character method passes regexMatchingTimeoutMillis (here 300), logs the WARN `json-rpc method regex evaluation timed out after {}ms for pattern:{}— treating as non-match`, and the request does not match. A short method fails within the budget; a normal regex still matches.

steps.note: Java backtracking passes the 300 ms budget: no match
a short method fails within the budget: no timeout entry
